comparison.objective: Commission and lock a damper vs safely saw a specified-thickness bread slice.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key insertion, collar tuning, counterholding, and bounded tightening vs knife grasping, loaf stabilization, guarded sawing, and cut-depth control.
comparison.success_condition: Repeated non-bottoming stops and setting retention vs a 1–2 cm released slice with continuous blade-clearance compliance.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization and force control are generic; the mechanisms and measured results differ.
